title: Universal Textual Teaching for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.12114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from stronger Teacher models to weaker Student models, but most methods require training the Student parameters, thereby binding the distilled knowledge to a specific architecture and checkpoint. This implicit representation is difficult to interpret or reuse across models and limits KD for API-only or costly-to-train models. This paper studies knowledge transfer for large language models (LLMs). We introduce Universal Textual Teaching (UTT), a parameter-update-free framework that distills observed Teacher-Student knowledge gaps into a textual, interpretable, and reusable natural-language artifact called Primer. translated_title: 面向大语言模型的通用文本教学
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏（KD）将知识从更强的教师模型传递给较弱的学生模型，但大多数方法需要训练学生模型参数，从而将蒸馏得到的知识绑定到特定的架构和检查点上。这种隐式表示难以解释，也难以在模型间复用，并限制了知识蒸馏在仅提供API接口或训练成本高昂的模型上的应用。本文研究大语言模型（LLM）的知识迁移问题。我们提出了通用文本教学（UTT），这是一个无需更新参数的框架，它将观察到的教师-学生知识差距蒸馏为一种称为Primer的文本化、可解释且可复用的自然语言产物。具体而言，UTT首先通过配对评估识别具有代表性的差距案例，随后通过多角色交互迭代更新Primer：学生模型尝试完成每个任务，提示器将评估反馈转化为教学指令，教师模型提供针对性的反馈。
tldr: UTT提出了一种无需更新参数的知识蒸馏框架，将教师与学生模型间的知识差距转化为可解释、可复用的自然语言“教材”（Primer），从而实现对仅提供API或训练成本高昂的模型的知识迁移。
en_tdlr: UTT is a parameter-update-free framework that distills observed Teacher-Student knowledge gaps into an interpretable and reusable natural-language artifact called Primer, enabling knowledge transfer to API-only or costly-to-train LLMs.
